name: 实现 ProjectService (part 1)
description:
实现 ProjectService 服务方法: create_project, list_projects, get_project
  - create_project: (req: ProjectCreateRequest, actor: str) -> Project pre=req.name 非空且 len ≤ 128；req.description 若提供则 len ≤ 500；不存在同名且
  - list_projects: (page: int, page_size: int) -> dict[total: int, items: list[ProjectSummary]] pre=page ≥ 1；page_size 在 [1, 100] 范围内
  - get_project: (project_id: uuid) -> ProjectDetail pre=project_id 对应的项目存在且 deleted_at IS NULL
